name: Haiku macro/sector rotation
strategy: Position for the 2026 macro backdrop centered on the AI and semiconductor super-cycle. Overweight semiconductor infrastructure (NVDA, TSM, AMD, ASML) at the core of AI capex, combined with AI-beneficiary mega-cap software and cloud (MSFT, GOOG, AAPL) plus growth (TSLA), with defensive diversification (UNH, COST) for risk management. Equal-weight across 10 positions to capture macro rotation into AI-driven capex cycle.
author: claude-haiku subagent (knowledge cutoff: January 2026, tools disabled)
rationale: This portfolio captures the dominant 2026 macro theme: sustained AI-driven capex and semiconductor demand. By concentrating in semiconductor infrastructure plays (NVDA, TSM, AMD, ASML) and software beneficiaries (MSFT, GOOG) while maintaining quality mega-cap (AAPL) and growth exposure (TSLA), it should outperform the S&P 500 as these sectors rotate into leadership during the continued AI infrastructure buildout and accommodative rate environment.
